name: smwsprites-secret-of-mana-crab
title: Secret Of Mana Crab
description:
The crab from Secret of Mana's Season's Forest and Mana Forest. It will walk around, either falling off or staying on ledges (depending on the extra bit) and will sometimes throw its pincer, which will fly around in an ellipse and return to the crab.

Mario needs to jump on it twice or spinjump on it to kill it.

Two palettes are included, one for the red crab from the Season's Forest and one for the metal crab from the Mana Fortress.
